name: splitcode
description: SplitCode — split large JS, TS, HTML or Python files into smaller dependency-ordered files with pure static analysis. No bundler, drop-in loader.
author: unn-Known1 <ptelgm.yt@gmail.com>

scripts.prepack: node --check split-js.js && node --check lib/backend.js && node --check lib/frontend-js.js && node --check lib/frontend-ts.js && node --check lib/frontend-html.js && node --check lib/frontend-py.js && node --check lib/preflight.js
